description: This file declares the WindowManagerConnector class and its nested WindowManagerNotification class, which interface with the IRDKWindowManager for managing window displays and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: WindowManagerConnector
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing window display creation, plugin initialization, and notification handling within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: WindowManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class implementing the IRDKWindowManager::INotification interface to handle window manager notifications such as user inactivity.

methods.name: initializePlugin
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service interface.

methods.name: releasePlugin
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the plugin.

methods.name: createDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display with specified application instance ID, display name, user ID, and group ID.

methods.name: isPluginInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the plugin has been successfully initialized.

methods.name: getDisplayInfo
methods.description: Retrieves display information such as XDG runtime directory and Wayland display name.
